name: Blacklight
desc: Ultraviolet over the scene, done the way UV actually behaves — the lamp itself is nearly invisible and contributes only its weak violet tail, so what you see is everything else giving the light back at a longer wavelength: crystal faces igniting calcite-red, willemite-green and fluorite-blue as the tube crawls over them, drifting lint and fibres blazing white, and the things with no fluorophore in them staying stubbornly dark no matter how hard they are lit.

energy.doc: lamp output — field brightness, throw radius and how hard everything fluoresces

scale.doc: size of the fluorescing bodies and the lamp's footprint vs design size

density.doc: how much of the scene has a fluorophore in it (10–90 bodies, 24–190 airborne fibres)

sweep.doc: how far the tube travels from its home position — 0 pins it, 1 works the whole frame

hue.doc: the lamp's visible violet tail — the fluorescence colours are set by the style, not by this

style.doc: aesthetic — mineral: a UV mineral cabinet, angular crystal faces in the real short-wave colours with cleavage planes catching the light · inspection: cold clinical near-monochrome, a hard-edged lamp footprint, residue and fibres only · club: dayglo blooms and hot lint over a saturated violet room · negative: the whole read inverted onto a pale violet plate where everything that glows prints black

act.doc: multi-minute programme — sweep: the tube wanders the whole frame · scan: a slow systematic raster, inspecting · hold: the lamp sits still and the specimens drift through its field instead

seed.doc: body placement, mineral species, quantum yields, fibre paths (int)
